# Lake Ice-Out Tools by Chris Izworski
> Satellite-backed lake ice-out monitoring and probability tools for Lake Superior Provincial Park and a North American beta covering benchmark lakes across the northern United States and Canada.

## Key pages
- [LSPP Ice-Out Monitor](https://lspp-ice-out.vercel.app/): NASA GIBS MODIS/VIIRS true-color and NDSI snow/ice overlays with the original Lake Superior Provincial Park empirical model.
- [North America Lake Ice-Out Forecast](https://lspp-ice-out.vercel.app/north-america/): lake search, target-date ice-out probability, live U.S./Canadian forecast thaw drivers, NASA imagery replay and nearby-lake comparison.

## Model status
The LSPP monitor remains the established local implementation. The North American page is a beta architecture intended for spring 2027. Its current climatology is transparent and morphology-based; lake-specific historical calibration and automated satellite open-water classification are planned model layers and are not represented as complete.

## Author
Chris Izworski (https://chrisizworski.com). Related: Michigan Trout Report (https://michigantroutreport.com), Great Lakes Levels (https://greatlakeslevels.org), and Michigan Phenology (https://phenology.chrisizworski.com).
